input.command:
cd packages/onepiece/src
# Use sed in-place. macOS sed needs '' after -i. Single quotes inside replacement work fine.
sed -i '' \
  -e "s|from '\\.\\./types'|from '@manamesh/frontend/src/game/modules/types'|g" \
  -e 's|from "\.\./types"|from "@manamesh/frontend/src/game/modules/types"|g' \
  -e "s|from '\\.\\./\\.\\./\\.\\./deck/types'|from '@manamesh/frontend/src/deck/types'|g" \
  -e "s|from '\\.\\./\\.\\./\\.\\./assets/loader/loader'|from '@manamesh/frontend/src/assets/loader/loader'|g" \
  -e "s|from '\\.\\./\\.\\./\\.\\./assets/loader/local-loader'|from '@manamesh/frontend/src/assets/loader/local-loader'|g" \
  -e "s|from '\\.\\./\\.\\./\\.\\./assets/loader/cache'|from '@manamesh/frontend/src/assets/loader/cache'|g" \
  -e "s|from '\\.\\./\\.\\./\\.\\./assets/loader/types'|from '@manamesh/frontend/src/assets/loader/types'|g" \
  *.ts
echo "---verify no stale relative imports left---"
grep -n "from ['\"]\\.\\./" *.ts | head -10
echo "---verify @manamesh/frontend imports look right---"
grep -n "from ['\"]@manamesh/frontend" *.ts | head -10
input.description: Rewrite all external relative imports to @manamesh/frontend
